status: NON-EXECUTABLE EDITORIAL RESEARCH ONLY; draft PR, NOT integrated into app or live; no image bytes downloaded and no localStorage accessed
scope: Ten new individually sourced Wikimedia Commons file-page records for Guatemala (3), Belize (2), Costa Rica (3), and Panama (2); checked against existing main and PR #5 photo registries for duplicate file pages.
method: Read each exact Wikimedia Commons File page on 24 October 2026 for declared creator, licence, source description and depicted place; compared to other editorial registries. This is file-description metadata review, not independent pixel-level, derivative-rights or full copyright-chain clearance.
displayRequirements: Before any public use, inspect the actual rendered pixels, verify the latest file-page rights/history, credit creator, exact file URL, licence URL and modification status in a visible panel, and follow ShareAlike obligations for adapted CC BY-SA files. The 196 country gateway pin coordinates are not necessarily the photographed sites.
